items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Phil Spitalny's got a band at the Edgewater Beach and he needs a jazz trumpet player... so, I went there and I stayed there a very short time

ctx.x: Julie Stein -- he said, listen, Phil Spitalny's got a band at the Edgewater Beach and he needs a jazz trumpet player and he said, how would you like to have that? So, I thought this was a good time for me to get out of all this -- so, I went there and I stayed there a very short time because I couldn't take the band.
